title: Kick acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of acceleration during the kick as 300 m/s² using a = Δv/Δt.

title: Catch acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of acceleration during the catch as 200 m/s².

title: Velocity change for catch
description: Important: Correctly computes the change in velocity for the catch (Δv = v_final - v_initial), accounting for opposite directions.

title: Acceleration definition application
description: Important: Applies the average acceleration formula (a = Δv/Δt) to both interaction intervals.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent sign convention for velocity directions throughout the solution.

title: Unit inclusion
description: Optional: Includes correct units (m/s²) with both final acceleration values.

title: Ignoring uniform motion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses the 1s flight time in acceleration calculations instead of the contact times.

title: Sign error in Δv
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error when calculating Δv for the catch, e.g., adding instead of subtracting velocities.

title: Magnitude vs. vector confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses acceleration magnitude with vector acceleration (e.g., omitting negative sign for vector or including it for magnitude).
